selection.titleNormalization: German lowercase, Unicode NFD, remove combining marks; substring matching supports German compounds; Tempo requires a word boundary or following digit.
selection.familyRule: Transitive relatedTo links plus common SIM base IDs after removing trailing one-to-three-letter/one-to-three-digit suffix groups. Prior sample families are also excluded.
selection.selectionRule: Per era, take ascending seeded hash while skipping already selected families; fill any shortfall from remaining hashes across eras. No failure-reason quotas; no extra leaf or title searching.
selection.hashEncoding: UTF-8; individual selection hash has no trailing LF; selectedIdsSha256 hashes ordered IDs joined with LF and one final LF.
selection.leafHashScope: Uncompressed JSON bytes; bytes is the uncompressed byte length.
selection.yearRule: Four-digit year after / in the Drucksachennummer; otherwise first four characters of date.
selection.familyDeduplication: Transitive union across the fixed pool and all 34 prior records; relatedTo links and SIM base IDs. Lexicographically smallest ID names each union.

fixedPool.filter: Exact auditKeywordMatches from the predeclared title filter, before any prior-sample/family exclusions.
fixedPool.documentDefinition: locationAssessment.sources contains document; this records assessment provenance, not availability of a separately downloaded HTML document.
fixedPool.limitations: Descriptive cross-tabulation of the fixed 26-leaf pool only. Not representative and not a global rate estimate.

sourceAcquisition.atSemantics: The original fetch log calls this retrievedAt; the fetcher records it at the start of each attempt, not at completion.
sourceAcquisition.limits: Direct batch: only selected public official HTML URLs, no redirects, login, cookies, PDF/attachment bodies or follow-up URLs; no retry or rerun of that batch. A separate research-tool open attempted the same four timeout URLs without obtaining content. No replacement cases or source substitution.
sourceAcquisition.initialGuardLimitation: The initial guard caught direct HTTPError and HTML access checks, but failed to classify URLError proxy CONNECT denials. The batch completed before inspection; no requests were retried. The script guard was corrected after this run, and was not run again.
sourceAcquisition.accessBoundary: Local egress proxy CONNECT 403 Forbidden; not a verified HTTP 403 response from the official origin.
sourceAcquisition.fallbackScope: Only the four timeout cases 05–08 received one additional research-tool open each. No research-tool opens for the CONNECT-denied cases 09–24, no browser use and no further attempts. Exact fallback timestamps were not preserved in this evidence file.

gazetteer.titleNameCheckScope: Exact normalized name only; no mapper replay or geometry construction.

diagnosticControls.scope: Existing isolated baseline diagnostics, distinct from the final identical-input local replay recorded in repairVerification; neither establishes publication.

result.claim: Die geringe Kartenabdeckung wird auch durch Fehlklassifikationen, Extraktionslücken und fehlende genaue Ortszuordnungen mitverursacht. Nicht alle unverorteten Vorgänge sind inhaltlich ortslos.
result.scope: Diagnostic fixed title-filtered sample; no representative estimate, no extrapolation of a defect rate or achievable global mapped count.
result.mappedCountAfterRepairMeaning: No whole-catalogue estimate or post-repair live count is derived. Local sample counts are in repairVerification.

limitations: document in locationAssessment.sources is assessment provenance, not proof of a complete text or a fresh source read.
A text place can be correct while a point, whole-street line, section, bridge, stop or building geometry is not verified.
A general title does not establish absence of locations in the unavailable document body.
Case 04 has concrete measures in the HTML justification; it must not be classified as a proven placeless citywide topic.
No historical before/after street geometry or explanation of historical disappearance is inferred from case 02.

The isolated baseline controls do not certify final regression results; the separate local replay and targeted test counts are recorded in repairVerification. CI, merge and live revision 8 are still pending.
In the title-only final replays, previous document excerpts are deliberately absent. The result cannot be treated as a complete remapping of those published records.

repairVerification.evidencePolicy: Identical saved source evidence is replayed before and after. Unavailable full texts remain title-only; no source fetch, replacement case or population estimate.
repairVerification.comparisonScope: Identical inputs before and after for each record. For 20 traffic cases and 8 original regional cases only published titles are replayed; previous document excerpts are deliberately absent. This is not a full remapping of the corresponding published record.
repairVerification.original18EvidenceRestored: The retained evidence now continues after bzw. through Hurlebuschweg eine Querungshilfe zu errichten.; it remains a text section without geometry.

uiWording.meaning: Does not equate absence of a map geometry with absence of location evidence.
uiWording.verificationScope: Local implementation and existing UI suites; no new live claim.

reviewScope: Independent full product-diff review and final targeted follow-up: no blocking finding.
Twelve independent checks preserve parenthesized qualifications, semicolon scope and independent following section clauses.
A neutral von in a leading petitioner phrase does not act as a spatial boundary.
Sentence-ending abbreviations retain separate evidence; only bzw., Nr. and Hausnr. remain as observed reference exceptions.
Earlier shared-negation, quoted-sentence, address-range and regional-scope protections remain covered.

selection.filter: source === hannover-sim && auditKeywordMatches.length > 0 && status in [mapped, partial]
selection.order: Unchanged candidate-pool order; every matching record included.

positiveControls.evidencePolicy: Identical published title and deduplicated saved location.evidence document excerpts before and after. No current or complete official full texts; no RIS/PDF requests; no additional selection.
positiveControls.comparison: Every baseline-replay mapped kind + exact label + complete geometry is compared with the after replay. Geometry object keys are canonicalized; coordinate values and order remain exact. A record retaining some other marker does not satisfy this comparison.
